taskIntent: Plugin failures should update already-open diagnostics promptly without forcing unrelated plugin views to refresh.

design.data: Preserve the existing single immutable diagnostics array and its 100-entry cap. No second registry, state store or persistence layer.
design.notification: Add a dedicated diagnostics subscriber channel with stable function identity; notify after replacing the diagnostics snapshot. Do not publish the registry or invalidate slot arrays for diagnostic-only errors.
design.consumer: Bind the existing production PluginSettings getDiagnostics snapshot to the dedicated subscription.
design.lifecycle: Unsubscribe detaches callbacks; dispose clears listeners. A diagnostic listener failure must not recursively record itself or replace the original command error.
design.scheduling: Prefer direct diagnostics notification unless mounted evidence demonstrates a need for deferred scheduling. Current observed renderer error is reported in componentDidCatch, not render or getDerivedStateFromError. Do not invent a React render-phase bug.
design.possibleDeferredAlternative: Only if justified: one pending microtask per host, immediate data update, no listener after dispose; requires ordering and cancellation coverage. Not currently required.

hostTests: Extend existing async command and bridge error tests near lines346-375: first activate and stabilize plugin, then subscribe diagnostics; error causes diagnostics notification while original error is preserved.
Observe global and slot subscriber counts/references remain unchanged by diagnostic-only publication.
Extend stable snapshot tests near376-396: unchanged reads return same reference; actual record produces new frozen snapshot.
Check cap100, ordering, unsubscribe and dispose for actual diagnostic events.
mountedTests: Use a production PluginSettings already mounted with a stable ancestor. Trigger an active plugin command failure and renderer-local failure without closing/reopening Settings or causing lifecycle/global publication.

Verify count/list update, original local fallback behavior remains, and no newly introduced cross-component update warning. Preserve expected development React rendering error instead of suppressing all page errors.
coverageGaps: Existing browser85-110 renderer retry test and177-220 bridge failure test cover local fallback/alert only.
Fixture was not read in this bounded research, so existing production Settings mounting and ancestor isolation are not yet established.

primarySources.relevance: Error boundary reporting lifecycle; development error bubbling differs from production.
Subscription notification and cached snapshot identity contract.

performanceBoundary: No measured PluginView performance regression. Measure notification, render and renderer commit counts separately before proposing per-plugin registry subscriptions. Stable effect keys do not imply remount on every global publication.

cleanCode.scope: One-data-source notification design and test seam
cleanCode.findings: Avoid global publication coupling, speculative scheduling, duplicate registry and implementation-mirroring tests.
cleanCode.resolution: Separate diagnostic notification responsibility and verify user-visible existing Settings behavior.
cleanCode.unresolved: Actual behavior test and exact current main/claim scope must be verified by assigned owner.
